import os,tempfile,sysconfig,json
from pathlib import Path
os.chdir(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="kg-mnp-clean-probe-"))
import kg_mnp
assert Path(kg_mnp.__file__).is_relative_to(Path(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"]))
from kg_mnp.contracts.catalog import verify_catalog_lock
verify_catalog_lock()
from kg_mnp.semantic_kernel.policy import load_compiler_policy
from kg_mnp.lifecycle.policy import load_policy
assert load_compiler_policy()["policy_id"]
assert load_policy("release-policy-1.0.0.yaml")["policy_id"]
from kg_mnp.services.facade import ApplicationService
from kg_mnp.services.models import ServiceConfiguration
from kg_mnp.api.app import create_app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
service = ApplicationService(ServiceConfiguration(tempfile.mkdtemp()))
with TestClient(create_app(service)) as client:
    statuses={path:client.get(path).status_code for path in ["/","/projects/example/overview","/api/v1/projects","/api/v1/not-a-resource"]}
    assert list(statuses.values()) == [200,200,401,404]
    assert "token_digest" not in client.get("/service-data/tokens.json").text
print(json.dumps({"version":kg_mnp.__version__,"status_codes":statuses,"imported_from_site_packages":True}))
